description: phpunit.xml's defaultTestSuite is Unit,Feature, so the module-local tests never run in a bare artisan test. Adding them takes measured coverage from 43.5% to 44.2%, with TaskRunner going 6.0% to 22.0%. Blocked on every remediation issue that the failure-cluster ticket produces, not just on the report itself. Re-measure rather than reusing the recorded percentages.
title: Move Modules into the default test suite once green
